prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1393; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Pearland, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the roadway with visible front-end and driver-side damage. Driver 1 stated that they were proceeding straight through the intersection when Driver 2, traveling in the opposing direction, began a left turn and struck the front driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they did not see Driver 1's vehicle until immediately before impact. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and reported no injuries at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and stated that the back strain began shortly after the collision. Both vehicles were driven from the scene with towing required for one. Traffic signal phase records and witness statements were requested for follow-up. Driver 2 was issued a citation for failure to yield the right-of-way while turning left.
